title.zh: COP31气候谈判未能达成重大协议，分歧暴露无遗
title.en: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions

summary.zh: COP31气候大会因是否提及化石燃料的争执而破裂，未能就应对气候变化达成重要协议。谈判暴露出各方在能源转型路径上的深刻分歧，会议成果有限。
summary.en: The COP31 climate summit collapsed without a major agreement after a dispute over whether to mention fossil fuels. The talks laid bare deep divisions among parties over how to move away from fossil energy.

reports.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
Cop31 climate talks break down as key deal rejected

title.zh: 俄军舰在班加西疑遭乌克兰无人机袭击后沉没
title.en: Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack

summary.zh: 一艘停靠利比亚班加西港补给加油的俄海军轻型护卫舰“水星”号疑似遭乌克兰海上无人机袭击，夜间发生剧烈爆炸后沉没，目前无一方宣称负责。利比亚东部政府官员称该舰受损严重。
summary.en: A Russian navy corvette, the Merkury, docked in Libya's Benghazi for refuelling was struck in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, triggering a night-time explosion and sinking the vessel. No group has claimed responsibility; eastern Libyan officials reported severe damage.

reports.title: Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack
Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say

title.zh: 2028年Anthropic用电将有87%来自天然气、11%来自煤炭
title.en: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028

summary.zh: 一篇分析文章拆解了AI数据中心的电力来源，指出到2028年Anthropic的供电结构中约87%来自天然气、11%来自煤炭。该数据引发对AI算力扩张与碳排放之间矛盾的讨论。
summary.en: An analysis breaking down power sources for AI data centers says about 87% of Anthropic's electricity will come from natural gas and 11% from coal in 2028. The figures have sparked debate over the climate costs of expanding AI compute.

reports.title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028

title.zh: 丰田、日产与本田将统一零部件规格以降低成本
title.en: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs

summary.zh: 据《Car and Driver》报道，日本三大车企丰田、日产和本田计划推进零部件标准化，以摊薄采购与生产成本。此举被视为在电动化转型与价格竞争加剧背景下，日系车企协同降本的最新动作。
summary.en: Toyota, Nissan and Honda plan to standardize parts in an effort to cut procurement and production costs, according to Car and Driver. The move is seen as the latest step by Japanese automakers to cooperate on cost reduction amid electrification and intensifying price competition.

reports.title: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs

title.zh: 巴林称伊朗袭击其工业设施，防空系统拦截来袭攻击
title.en: Bahrain says Iran strikes industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks - Reuters

summary.zh: 巴林表示伊朗对其一处工业设施发动袭击，防空系统已对来袭目标实施拦截。事件使海湾地区紧张局势进一步升级，具体损失情况尚待确认。
summary.en: Bahrain said Iran struck an industrial facility and that its air defences intercepted the incoming attacks. The incident raises Gulf tensions; details on damage were not immediately clear.

reports.title: Bahrain says Iran strikes industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks - Reuters
Saudi Arabia, Bahrain report new attacks as Iran says it remains open to a deal with U.S.

title.zh: Notable Capital、GIC与Baillie Gifford在Anthropic上市前大举下注
title.en: How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO

summary.zh: 三家重要投资方讲述了它们为何有信念向Anthropic投入数十亿美元。报道聚焦于这些机构在Anthropic IPO前形成判断的依据。
summary.en: Three major backers explain what gave them the conviction to invest billions of dollars in Anthropic. The report focuses on how these firms formed their judgments ahead of the company's IPO.

reports.title: How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO

title.zh: OpenAI发文探讨困惑度与智能
title.en: Perplexity and Intelligence

summary.zh: OpenAI官网发布题为《Perplexity and Intelligence》的文章，讨论困惑度（perplexity）这一指标与智能之间的关系。文章在技术社区引发较多讨论。
summary.en: OpenAI published an article titled "Perplexity and Intelligence," examining the relationship between the perplexity metric and intelligence. The post drew substantial discussion in technical communities.

reports.title: Perplexity and Intelligence

title.zh: 芬兰称俄罗斯开始拖走波罗的海遭无人机袭击船只
title.en: Russia starts towing ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland says - Reuters

summary.zh: 芬兰方面表示，俄罗斯已开始拖走一艘在波罗的海遭无人机袭击受损的船只。事件发生在波罗的海紧张局势持续之际，相关细节尚未完全披露。
summary.en: Finland said Russia has begun towing a ship that was hit by drones in the Baltic Sea. The incident comes amid heightened tensions in the region; further details were not immediately available.

reports.title: Russia starts towing ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland says - Reuters

title.zh: 科学界不断发现化学物质与“生活方式病”相关，欧洲却放松监管
title.en: Europe weakens chemical rules as science links them to 'lifestyle diseases'

summary.zh: 《世界报》评论指出，越来越多科学研究显示化学物质在所谓“生活方式病”中扮演角色，而欧洲却在此时削弱相关化学品法规。文章批评监管与科学证据之间出现脱节。
summary.en: A Le Monde opinion piece argues that Europe is weakening chemical regulations even as research increasingly links certain substances to so-called lifestyle diseases. It criticizes the growing gap between regulatory policy and scientific evidence.

reports.title: Europe weakens chemical rules as science links them to 'lifestyle diseases'

title.zh: 开放社交网络联盟成立
title.en: Open Social Web Alliance

summary.zh: 一个名为“Open Social Web Alliance”的联盟上线，旨在推动开放社交网络生态的发展。相关讨论在技术社区获得关注，涉及去中心化与互操作性等议题。
summary.en: A group called the Open Social Web Alliance has launched a site aimed at promoting an open social web ecosystem. The initiative drew attention in tech circles, touching on decentralization and interoperability.

reports.title: Open Social Web Alliance

title.zh: 财新：稳市场三项新政出台
title.en: Caixin: Three new policies rolled out to stabilize the market

summary.zh: 财新报道，监管部门推出三项新政以稳定市场，涉及相关制度与政策调整。具体措施旨在提振市场信心、维护运行稳定。
summary.en: Caixin reports that regulators have introduced three new policies aimed at stabilizing the market. The measures involve institutional and policy adjustments intended to bolster confidence and support orderly trading.

reports.title: 财新闻｜稳市场，三项新政来了 - 财新

title.zh: 民主党翻转北卡罗来纳州席位，赢得1992年以来最大众议院多数
title.en: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat

summary.zh: 民主党在中期选举中翻转北卡罗来纳州一个席位，已至少赢得258个众议院席位，共和党至少获得173席。这是民主党自1992年以来在众议院取得的最大多数优势。
summary.en: Democrats have won at least 258 House seats to the Republicans' 173 after flipping a North Carolina seat in the midterms. It marks the party's largest House majority since 1992.

reports.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat

title.zh: “危险似乎与日俱增”：乌克兰民众在俄军袭击后搜寻失踪者
title.en: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes

summary.zh: 在乌克兰基辅地区一栋住宅楼遭俄军袭击坍塌后，救援人员和居民正搜寻失踪者。BBC记者在现场报道称，当地民众感到危险日益加剧。
summary.en: Rescuers and residents in Ukraine's Kyiv region are searching for the missing after a residential building collapsed in Russian strikes. The BBC's correspondent at the scene reported that people feel danger is growing all the time.

reports.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes

title.zh: OpenAI首席科学家谈如何限制AI发展
title.en: OpenAI’s chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development

summary.zh: OpenAI首席科学家就如何给AI发展设定“限速”提出看法，指出关键在于各方必须先就衡量AI进展速度的标准达成一致，否则限速无从谈起。这一表态反映出业界对AI研发节奏与安全治理的持续争论。
summary.en: OpenAI's chief scientist weighed in on setting a speed limit for AI development, arguing that agreement on how to measure speed must come first. The remark highlights the ongoing debate over the pace of AI research and safety governance.

reports.title: OpenAI’s chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development

title.zh: 本地AI入门指南：Inkling、Qwen与Unsloth
title.en: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth

summary.zh: 一篇技术博客介绍如何用Inkling、Qwen与Unsloth在本地运行AI模型，面向初学者讲解部署与优化流程。该文在Hacker News获得226点热度与84条评论。
summary.en: A technical blog post offers a beginner-friendly walkthrough for running AI models locally using Inkling, Qwen and Unsloth, covering setup and optimization. It drew 226 points and 84 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth

title.zh: 硅谷究竟发生了什么？
title.en: What Happened to Silicon Valley?

summary.zh: O'Reilly Radar刊文回顾硅谷的演变，探讨其文化与创新生态如何偏离早期理想。该文在Hacker News引发热烈讨论，获得429点与245条评论。
summary.en: An O'Reilly Radar essay reflects on how Silicon Valley's culture and innovation ecosystem drifted from its early ideals. The piece sparked extensive discussion on Hacker News with 429 points and 245 comments.

reports.title: What Happened to Silicon Valley?
Jensen Huang's fall is bad news for Silicon Valley's accelerationists

title.zh: 数据中心为何成为大型科技公司遭反弹的焦点
title.en: Why data centers are at the center of the Big Tech backlash

summary.zh: 记者帕里斯·马克思在新书《Hyperscale》中剖析数据中心扩张引发的争议，解释其为何成为针对大型科技公司不满情绪的核心。讨论涉及能耗、土地与社区影响等议题。
summary.en: Journalist Paris Marx discusses his new book "Hyperscale," examining why data center expansion has become the focal point of public backlash against Big Tech. The conversation touches on energy use, land and community impacts.

reports.title: Why data centers are at the center of the Big Tech backlash

title.zh: “氛围编程”革命将蔓延到各类设备
title.en: The vibe-coding revolution is coming to all the gadgets

summary.zh: Tech columnist David Pierce在周报The Stepback中探讨AI驱动的“氛围编程”正扩散至各类消费电子产品。文章梳理这一趋势的由来，并分析其对软件开发与硬件生态的潜在影响。
summary.en: In his weekly newsletter The Stepback, David Pierce explores how AI-driven "vibe coding" is spreading to all kinds of gadgets. He traces the trend's origins and its potential impact on software and hardware ecosystems.

reports.title: The vibe-coding revolution is coming to all the gadgets

title.zh: 宇树科技股价大涨，重回600元以上
title.en: Unitree Technology shares surge, climbing back above 600 yuan

summary.zh: 第一财经报道，宇树科技股价大幅上涨，重新站上600元关口。报道未说明具体涨幅及上涨原因，此次反弹显示市场对其关注度仍高。
summary.en: Yicai reported that Unitree Technology shares rose sharply, returning above the 600 yuan mark. The report did not specify the gain or the reason, but the rebound signals continued market interest in the company.

reports.title: 宇树科技大涨 股价重回到600元以上 - 第一财经

title.zh: 享界V8上市：采用L3架构，起售价31.98万元，2小时大定超2200辆
title.en: Stelato V8 launches: L3 architecture, starting at 319,800 yuan, over 2,200 orders in two hours

summary.zh: 享界V8正式上市，采用L3级智能驾驶架构，起售价31.98万元。上市两小时内大定订单突破2200辆，显示市场对该车型初期反响积极。
summary.en: The Stelato V8 has launched with an L3 autonomous-driving architecture and a starting price of 319,800 yuan. Firm orders exceeded 2,200 units within two hours of the launch.

reports.title: 闪电快讯 | 享界V8上市：采用L3架构 起售价31.98万，2小时大定超2200辆 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 美银美林：芯片股“触底”需先“利率见顶”，建议待股价不再理会利空时抄底
title.en: BofA: chip stocks' 'bottoming' requires 'peak rates', wait to buy the dip when 'prices stop reacting to bad news'

summary.zh: 美银美林认为，芯片股的真正见底前提是利率见顶，当前尚不具备该条件。该行建议投资者耐心等待，待市场出现“股价不再理会利空”的信号后再行抄底。
summary.en: Bank of America Merrill Lynch says chip stocks cannot truly bottom until interest rates peak. It advises investors to wait for signs that share prices no longer respond to negative news before buying the dip.

reports.title: 美银美林：芯片股“触底”需要“利率见顶”，等待“股价不再理会利空”时抄底 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 重大科技宕机事件远未结束
title.en: We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages

summary.zh: 过去一周，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）一度全国停飞，Outlook 连续多日故障导致企业停摆，摩根大通也出现银行系统中断。美国国家情报总监克莱顿等人警告，此类大规模技术故障还会继续出现。
summary.en: Over the past week the US saw an FAA nationwide ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage that brought companies to a standstill, and a JPMorgan Chase banking outage. Officials including the Director of National Intelligence warn that more large-scale tech failures are coming.

reports.title: We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages

title.zh: 美国情报总监称完全信任特朗普对普京“我的朋友”的描述
title.en: US intelligence chief says he trusts Trump’s description of Putin as ‘my friend’

summary.zh: 美国国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿表示，他“完全”信任特朗普；此前特朗普在中国与普京会晤后称普京为“朋友”。克莱顿在周日媒体采访中被追问这一表态。
summary.en: US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said he trusts Donald Trump “completely” after Trump described Vladimir Putin as “a friend” following their meeting in China. Clayton was pressed on the characterization during Sunday media appearances.

reports.title: US intelligence chief says he trusts Trump’s description of Putin as ‘my friend’

title.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯击败世界第一兹维列夫夺得ATP年终总决赛冠军
title.en: Alcaraz charges past world number one Zverev to clinch ATP Finals title - Reuters

summary.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯在ATP年终总决赛中战胜世界排名第一的兹维列夫，夺得冠军。路透社报道了这场胜利。
summary.en: Carlos Alcaraz beat world number one Alexander Zverev to win the ATP Finals title, Reuters reported. The victory capped his run at the season-ending tournament.

reports.title: Alcaraz charges past world number one Zverev to clinch ATP Finals title - Reuters
Alcaraz digs deep to beat Shelton, will face world number one Zverev in final - Reuters

title.zh: 美陆军不顾法院命令将在爱荷华州引爆数吨不稳定炸药
title.en: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order

summary.zh: 美国陆军表示，为保护爱荷华州弹药厂人员及附近社区，必须采取“迅速行动”。尽管法院命令阻止，军方仍计划引爆数吨不稳定炸药。
summary.en: The U.S. Army says it will detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite a court order. It argues swift action is needed to protect personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant.

reports.title: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order

title.zh: Show HN：我开发了一款让你扮演 LLM 子代理的游戏
title.en: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent

summary.zh: 一位开发者在 Hacker News 展示其新游戏，玩家扮演大语言模型的“子代理”执行任务。该帖获得 272 点热度与 64 条评论。
summary.en: A developer showcased a browser game in which the player acts as a subagent carrying out tasks for a large language model. The Hacker News post drew 272 points and 64 comments.

reports.title: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent

title.zh: 韩国教育部长因考试作弊丑闻辞职
title.en: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal

summary.zh: 韩国教育部长崔教镇因大学入学考试作弊丑闻辞职。他承认，为防止AI辅助作弊而采取的临场措施引发了混乱。
summary.en: South Korea’s education minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned over an exam cheating scandal. He admitted that last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating in the college entrance exam caused chaos.

reports.title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal

title.zh: 印尼一糖果厂发生火灾 至少3人死亡数十人失踪
title.en: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing

summary.zh: 雅加达以西一家糖果厂发生火灾，至少3人死亡、36人失踪。救援人员进入烧毁建筑搜寻失踪者，厂房屋顶部分坍塌。
summary.en: A fire at a confectionery factory west of Jakarta killed at least three people and left 36 missing, a rescue official said. Rescue workers searched the charred building as relatives gathered for news.

reports.title: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing
Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory

title.zh: 写给下一个百个 Rust GUI 的建议
title.en: Advice for the next 100 Rust GUIs

summary.zh: Linebender 项目发布博客文章，回顾 Rust 图形界面开发的实践经验，并就未来一百个 Rust GUI 项目给出建议。该讨论在 Hacker News 获得 254 点热度、148 条评论。
summary.en: The Linebender project published a blog post sharing lessons from building GUIs in Rust and offering advice for the next hundred such efforts. The Hacker News discussion drew 254 points and 148 comments.

reports.title: Advice for the next 100 Rust GUIs

title.zh: 印度曼尼普尔邦至少11人饮用掺假酒精后死亡
title.en: At least 11 die after drinking adulterated alcohol in India's Manipur state - Reuters

summary.zh: 印度曼尼普尔邦发生饮用掺假酒精事件，至少11人死亡。路透社报道了这一伤亡情况。
summary.en: At least 11 people died in India’s Manipur state after drinking adulterated alcohol, Reuters reported. The incident raised concerns about illegal liquor safety.

reports.title: At least 11 die after drinking adulterated alcohol in India's Manipur state - Reuters

title.zh: 国际棋联将卡尔森因布达佩斯赛事弃权事件移交纪律机构
title.en: Chess-FIDE refers Carlsen to disciplinary body over forfeits at Budapest chess event - Reuters

summary.zh: 国际棋联就卡尔森在布达佩斯国际象棋赛事中的弃权行为，将其移交纪律机构处理。路透社报道称，此事进入纪律审查程序。
summary.en: FIDE has referred Magnus Carlsen to its disciplinary body over forfeits at a chess event in Budapest, Reuters reported. The case now enters a disciplinary review process.

reports.title: Chess-FIDE refers Carlsen to disciplinary body over forfeits at Budapest chess event - Reuters

title.zh: 智能驾驶概念股震荡拉升
title.en: Smart-driving concept stocks swing higher

summary.zh: 第一财经报道，智能驾驶概念板块盘中震荡拉升。报道未披露具体个股与涨幅细节，市场对该板块的关注度回升。
summary.en: Yicai reported that smart-driving concept stocks swung higher during trading. The report gave no specifics on individual shares or gains, though attention to the sector picked up.

reports.title: 智能驾驶概念震荡拉升 - 第一财经

title.zh: 华为新品牌星芒推出阔直板AI手机OSTA O1 Pro，5499元起售
title.en: Huawei's new brand Xingmang launches wide-screen bar-style AI phone OSTA O1 Pro from 5,499 yuan

summary.zh: 华为全新品牌星芒发布阔直板AI手机OSTA O1 Pro，起售价5499元。该机型主打AI功能与宽屏直板形态，被视为华为在细分高端市场的新布局。
summary.en: Huawei's new brand Xingmang has released the OSTA O1 Pro, a wide-screen bar-style AI phone starting at 5,499 yuan. The device emphasizes AI features and marks Huawei's push into a niche premium segment.

reports.title: 闪电快讯 | 华为全新品牌星芒阔直板AI手机OSTA O1 Pro以5499元起售 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 中国球员刘因假球调查被停赛
title.en: Chinese player Liu suspended amid match-fixing probe - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，一名中国球员刘因涉及假球调查被停赛。报道未提供更多细节。
summary.en: Reuters reports that a Chinese player named Liu has been suspended amid a match-fixing investigation. Further details were not immediately provided.

reports.title: Chinese player Liu suspended amid match-fixing probe - Reuters

title.zh: 埃里克·特朗普背书的机器人初创公司现金流告急，员工失去医保福利
title.en: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens

summary.zh: 由埃里克·特朗普背书的机器人初创公司Foundation在现金短缺加剧之际，已停止为员工提供医疗保险。该公司正寻求紧急过桥贷款，并与多家风投机构洽谈，同时等待韩国Base Group承诺的1.5亿美元投资到账。
summary.en: Foundation, a robotics startup backed by Eric Trump, has cut employee health benefits as its cash crunch worsens. The company is seeking an emergency bridge loan and talking to venture firms while awaiting a $150 million investment from South Korea's Base Group.

reports.title: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens

title.zh: 研究：英格兰银行董事从英国废除奴隶制后古巴奴役中非法获利
title.en: Bank of England directors illegally profited from post-abolition enslavement in Cuba

summary.zh: 新研究发现，由英格兰银行长期任职董事经营的英国企业，在英国帝国废除奴隶制后数十年间，仍通过古巴埃尔科布雷铜矿的残酷奴役获利。研究称奴隶贸易财富已嵌入英国金融体系。
summary.en: New research finds that British businesses run by long-serving Bank of England directors profited for decades from brutal enslavement in Cuba after slavery was abolished in the British empire. The El Cobre copper mine used enslaved men and boys in prison-like conditions, and slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system.

reports.title: Bank of England directors illegally profited from post-abolition enslavement in Cuba

title.zh: A股开盘两市双双低开，沪指跌0.86%
title.en: Markets open lower: Shanghai Composite down 0.86%

summary.zh: 今日A股开盘，沪深两市双双低开，上证指数下跌0.86%。市场整体情绪偏谨慎，开盘走弱。
summary.en: Chinese stocks opened lower on both the Shanghai and Shenzhen bourses, with the Shanghai Composite Index falling 0.86%. Sentiment was cautious at the open.

reports.title: 今日开盘：两市双双低开 沪指跌幅0.86% - 财新

title.zh: 联合国最新气候大会艰难收场
title.en: The messy breakdown of the UN's latest climate conference

summary.zh: 联合国最新一届气候大会在激烈分歧中落幕，各方连总结文件中是否提及化石燃料都无法达成一致。谈判僵局凸显全球气候治理在能源转型问题上的深层裂痕。作为观察国际气候合作走向的风向标，此次会议结果值得细读，以判断未来减排承诺的可信度。
summary.en: The latest UN climate summit ended in disarray, with parties unable to agree even on whether the summary text should mention fossil fuels. The impasse highlights deep divisions over energy transition within global climate governance. The outcome is worth reading closely as a signal of how credible future emissions pledges will be.

title.zh: 地球刚经历有记录以来最异常炎热的一天
title.en: Earth just saw the most anomalously hot day ever on record

summary.zh: 全球刚刚录得有观测记录以来偏离气候平均值最显著的高温日。有生以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象仍在增强，这一纪录可能很快被再次刷新。极端高温密集出现，意味着气候风险正从统计异常转为现实冲击，其对农业、电力与公共健康的具体影响值得关注。
summary.en: Earth has just recorded its most anomalously hot day on record. With the strongest El Niño in living memory still gaining strength, the record could soon be broken again. The surge in extremes matters because climate risk is shifting from statistical anomaly to everyday disruption for farming, power grids and public health.

title.zh: AI 行情还能挤出多少空间？
title.en: How much more air can come out of the AI trade?

summary.zh: 围绕人工智能概念的市场交易正遭遇波动，投资者开始重新审视高估值的可持续性。文章认为市场的担忧并非无的放矢，而是对盈利兑现节奏与资本开支回报的合理质疑。对关注科技股泡沫争论的读者而言，这篇分析提供了判断行情纵深的关键视角。
summary.en: The market trade built around artificial intelligence is wobbling as investors reassess stretched valuations. The piece argues the unease is well founded, reflecting real doubts about how quickly profits will arrive and whether capex will pay off. It offers a useful lens for anyone weighing whether the AI rally still has room to run.

title.zh: 勃起功能障碍药物或对阿尔茨海默病有效
title.en: Erectile dysfunction drug could hold promise for Alzheimer's disease

summary.zh: 一项三期临床试验的早期结果显示，一款用于治疗勃起功能障碍的药物在阿尔茨海默病方面显现潜力。若后续数据能够证实，这将为长期缺乏有效手段的神经退行性疾病提供新思路。目前结论仍属初步，但该信号值得关注，因其可能指向老药新用的低成本路径。
summary.en: Early results from a phase III trial suggest an erectile dysfunction drug may hold promise against Alzheimer's disease. If later data confirm the signal, it would open a new avenue for a neurodegenerative condition that still lacks effective treatment. The findings are preliminary, but notable for pointing to a low-cost repurposing path.
